title: Install and configure Prettier
description: Install Prettier code formatter and configure it with project-wide formatting rules. Create a .prettierrc config file and add a format script to package.json.
acceptanceCriteria: prettier is installed as a devDependency
npm run format exits with code 0

steps.details: Run: `npm install --save-dev prettier`. Install the latest version.
Create .prettierrc at project root with the following JSON content: { "singleQuote": true, "semi": false, "trailingComma": "all", "printWidth": 100, "tabWidth": 2 }
Create .prettierignore at project root excluding: dist/, node_modules/, src/templates/ (template files should not be reformatted), coverage/
Add to the scripts object in package.json: 'format': 'prettier --write "src/**/*.ts" "bin/**/*.ts"'. Also add 'format:check': 'prettier --check "src/**/*.ts" "bin/**/*.ts"' for CI.
Run `npm run format` on the current source files. Should exit 0. Then run `npm run format:check` — should also exit 0 after formatting.

technicalNotes: Template files in src/templates/ should be excluded from Prettier to preserve intentional formatting in generated files
Consider adding a pre-commit hook with lint-staged to auto-format on commit (optional, not required for v1)
